description: Linux ONLY. Tauri implements page zoom on Linux as a JS polyfill that calls the core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom IPC command; a remote origin can only reach IPC if a capability grants it (Phase 0 report section 6.3). This grants exactly that one command to the daemon's loopback origin and nothing else, so Ctrl +/-/0 and Ctrl+wheel resize text (WCAG 1.4.4). Windows needs no permission - WebView2 maps zoom to a native setting - and keeps the empty default set.
